string-array.name: release_notes
string-array.item: Hold a search result for a menu of what you can do with it: App info and Pin to home for apps; Call, Message and Copy number for contacts; Open with, Share and Copy path for files. Anything you\'ve opened before can be removed from your recents.
\"Add to home screen\" works: a website from Chrome, a contact or a playlist joins the pinned app wheel with its own icon, as long as there\'s room.

Apps in a work profile show up, marked \"(work)\" with the work badge, next to your personal copies. Pin them, put them on a quick-action button, find their shortcuts in search, and they open in the work profile.
The long-press menus are on the same dark glass as the rest of the launcher.
Search finds everything else a little sooner after you stop typing, and waits a little longer while battery saver is on or the phone is warm.
